persons.name: Kuñjalasiṃha
persons.evidence: śrīvajravidācāryyakuñjalasiṃhena śrīpraśnottarāvarī saṃpūrṇṇa siddha juyakaṃ coyā juro

date.as_written: abdanaipālike varṣe haya-ṛtu-gajānvite | māse māghe site paṣpe(!) dvitīyāyāṃ tithau bhṛguḥ | dhaneṣṭhākṣe sukarmmaṇa yogānvite ... samvat 867 māghaśukla tṛtīyāyāṃ tithau dhaneṣṭhānakṣatre sukarmmayoge śukravāre

notes: The chronogram in the verse gives haya (7) - ṛtu (6) - gaja (8) = NS 867, which agrees with the prose date (samvat 867). The verse gives tithi dvitīyā, whereas the prose specifies tṛtīyā.
